abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine the incidence of necrosis, teratoma, and active cancer in specimens at retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) after chemotherapy in patients who presented with a pure seminoma primary tumour and an elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) level at diagnosis who underwent surgery. PATIENTS AND METHODS: A retrospective review of the Indiana University testis cancer database from 1980 to 2004 was performed to identify all patients with metastasic germ cell cancer, pure seminoma in the orchidectomy specimen, and an elevated AFP level. In all, 42 patients were identified; two with nonseminomatous germ cell cancer in the contralateral testicle were excluded. RESULTS: RPLND pathology in the 40 patients showed necrosis in 13 (32.5%), teratoma in 12 (30%), and cancer in 15 (37.5%). The histological subtype of the 15 cancer specimens at RPLND was pure seminoma in two, embryonal in three, yolk sac in seven, variant in one, and mixed elements in two (one with seminoma and yolk sac, and one with embryonal and variant). In all, 20 patients presented with a serum AFP level of <1000 microg/mL with nine (45%) having teratoma only in the retroperitoneum in contrast to 20 patients with an AFP level of >1000 microg/mL with three (15%) having teratoma only in the retroperitoneum (P = 0.04). The level of serum AFP did not predict for active cancer in the retroperitoneum (P = 0.5). CONCLUSIONS: RPLND in patients after chemotherapy who presented with pure seminoma in the orchidectomy specimen and an elevated AFP do not have a high probability of finding necrosis only in the RPLND specimen. In fact, the prevalence of persistent cancer is higher compared with the general group of patients that have RPLND after chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣原発の純粋セミノーマかつ診断時に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇していた患者で、化学療法後に手術を受けた症例について、後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）の標本における壊死、奇形腫、活動性癌の頻度を明らかにすること。患者と方法：インディアナ大学の精巣がんデータベース（1980年〜2004年）を後方視的に検討し、転移性胚細胞腫瘍、精巣摘除標本で純粋セミノーマ、AFP上昇を示す全患者を抽出した。42例が同定されたが、対側精巣に非セミノーマを有する2例は除外した。結果：RPLND病理の40例では、壊死が13例（32.5%）、奇形腫が12例（30%）、癌が15例（37.5%）に認められた。RPLNDで癌と診断された15例の組織型は、純粋セミノーマが2例、胎児性癌が3例、卵黄嚢腫瘍が7例、変異型が1例、混合成分が2例（セミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍が1例、胎児性癌と変異型が1例）であった。40例中20例は血清AFPが1000µg/mL未満で、そのうち9例（45%）が後腹膜に奇形腫のみを有していた。一方、AFPが1000µg/mL超の20例では3例（15%）のみが後腹膜に奇形腫のみを有していた（P = 0.04）。血清AFP値は後腹膜の活動性癌を予測しなかった（P = 0.5）。結論：精巣摘除標本で純粋セミノーマを呈し、AFPが上昇していた化学療法後の患者では、RPLND標本のみに壊死を認める確率は高くない。実際、化学療法後にRPLNDを受けた患者の一般集団と比べて、持続的な癌の有病率はむしろ高い。
